custom_parsers.maintenance_risk: Zero deprecation warnings, tight in-tree maintenance

langchain_loaders.transitive_dependency_overhead: Very High (>35 transitive packages including nltk, numba, llvmlite, beautifulsoup4, html5lib, emoji)
langchain_loaders.external_services: None (local), but unstructured includes unstructured-client hooks
langchain_loaders.maintenance_risk: HIGH: langchain-community is deprecated and sunsetted by LangChain team with active DeprecationWarnings. Unstructured has frequent breaking releases.

custom_parsers.chunker_compatibility: Native 100% plug-and-play with ChunkingService. Uses page.page_number, page.sheet_name, title directly for citations.
custom_parsers.metadata_consistency: Uniform schema across all 4 file types (filename, file_type, title, ingestion_timestamp, file_size_bytes, total_pages, extra).
custom_parsers.table_support: First-class Markdown tables automatically generated from docx XML and openpyxl rows.
custom_parsers.legal_normalization: Integrated normalize_legal_text() for unicode cleaning, whitespace preservation, clause hierarchies, and hyphen repair.

langchain_loaders.chunker_compatibility: Incompatible out-of-the-box. Requires writing adapter classes to convert LangChain Document lists into ParsedDocument and ParsedPage instances.
langchain_loaders.metadata_consistency: Heterogeneous and fragmented. PyMuPDFLoader outputs 0-based 'page', Docx2txtLoader outputs only 'source', TextLoader outputs only 'source', Unstructured outputs 'page_name' and 'text_as_html'.
langchain_loaders.table_support: Poor. Docx2txt flattens tables to plain lines; Unstructured single-mode collapses table cells to space-separated words.
langchain_loaders.legal_normalization: None. Raw text is emitted with dirty whitespace, unnormalized unicode quotes, broken hyphenated linebreaks.
langchain_loaders.adapter_effort_required: High (~16-24 engineering hours to build, test, and maintain custom adapter layers for 4 different loader classes).
